proposal.reason: Primary change is in P2P transport IPC registration: it now registers/maps full multi-segment physical ranges, carries segment counts through register/deregister flows, and gates behavior with MULTI_SEGMENT_REGISTER. Include network because proxy/UDS behavior is substantively extended (batched FD conversion, proxy-side segment import/mapping lifecycle, per-connection handle tracking/cleanup). Include memory because allocation/mapping teardown semantics were changed for multi-segment ranges (segment-wise unmap/free, granularity checks, and segment-count-aware free helpers).
